findings.title: Unguarded null deref on empty input
findings.description: web/lib/parse.ts:42 calls input.split('-') without checking that input is non-null. The caller at web/app/page.tsx:128 passes `params.slug` which can legitimately be undefined when the route is hit without a slug segment. This will throw at runtime.
findings.suggested_action: Add an early return when input is null/undefined, or validate at the caller site. Whichever pattern is consistent with the rest of this codebase's null-handling convention.

findings.title: Test assertion contradicts function name
findings.description: web/lib/parse.test.ts:67 asserts that getActiveSlug() returns 'inactive' for archived rows. Either the function's name is wrong (it doesn't return only active slugs), or the assertion is testing the wrong condition.
findings.suggested_action: Decide which is right and align the other. If the function's contract is 'return slug regardless of active state', rename it; if it really should filter by active, fix the assertion.

new_questions: Is web/lib/parse.ts intended to be public API (it's exported and the path is in /lib) or internal helper? The lack of unit tests for the edge cases suggests internal, but the export suggests public.
